decisions.rationale: The first cha counts divisions in the question; exact glossary divisions. It is distinct from the following first division.

Genitive gi relates the objects to the four divisions, recast as objects for each. It owns this first for, not the later target of hatred; each of remains outside.
First gzhi asks for the objects; directly grounded in the local question and answer. The unrelated auto-mined give it a name remains unaltered and is not an authority.
The interrogative is what. Expanded things serve as is not made part of this pronoun.

The whole quotative conditional asks the question, recast as ask. This is a formula at d3, not a fabricated dictionary zhe/say or na/if atom; One might and initial o na remain outside. The auto-mined correct perception is irrelevant.
Second cha is the first division in the answer, not plural divisions in the question.
Established ordinal first, excluding the source bound genitive and English the.
Second gzhi owns the singular answer object; do not reuse the question objects.
First living-being compound gives the general object class, here plural. No sems/living or can/beings children.
The single copula of this class definition is consists of. Full yin record has consist of, with the local singular agreement. It does not own every subsequent supplied is.
The whole act name has exact HGM killing and is separate from the later explanatory srog gcod pa.
This second ni marks the topic-definition relation explicitly recast as killing is. Its unique is lies in this definition; the first ni before the overt yin remains omitted.
Second sems can names the one whose life is taken. Preserve singular being, excluding a; source occurrence differs from the class-level plural.
Genitive gyi relates life to this living being, represented by the of following life.
Whole killing compound explicitly has HGM take the life. The parent includes this attested idiomatic wording; supplied preceding infinitive to stays outside.
Life is the unique lexical member of the take-the-life parent, with exact HGM life.

The cutting predicate is idiomatically take inside take the life. HGM gcod pa lists cut/lose, not take; this member is supported by the complete local killing idiom and exact parent attestation, not falsely labeled a standalone take glossary match.
Whole established harmful-intent compound, exact HGM malice. Do not split its constituents into speculative English.
Third living-being compound is the target of malice, not the victim in the killing definition.
Target-marking la is for after hatred, supported by local syntax and the complete particle record.
The lexical hatred term has exact HGM hatred. The English support verb feel and auxiliary is to remain outside.
The whole established harsh-speech term owns the quotation subject, excluding its opening quotation mark.

Within this established parent, tshig is the speech/words member. Its standalone HGM list has words/quotation, not speech; the local parent and direct harsh modifier justify the transparent pairing without relabeling reference evidence.
Exact HGM harsh identifies the strictly tighter qualifier inside the harsh-speech parent.
Third ni marks the definition harsh speech is. Select the first is in this quoted relative construction; that which is remains supplied framing.
Whole negative term is explicitly HGM unpleasant; do not erase the negation or substitute the distinct vile-rumors sense.
Negative mi is the approved un affix inside unpleasant; the parent is unique and complete. This is the stated negative-affix convention, not arbitrary word splitting.

The positive audible-quality member lies inside unpleasant. Standalone HGM says good; reference pleasant and the exact complete negative parent ground this local transparent member, without calling pleasant a separate HGM gloss.

Keep the complete quotation-occurrence formula at d3, tightly recast as says. Root text itself is an English specification of the citation source, not an invented zhes/root-text atom; bound genitive remains outside.
The final explanatory causal particle introduces the quotation reason, rendered as. It is distinct from the earlier question serve as, which stays unwrapped.
